title: Agentic Data Cleaning Without a Clean Reference: An Experimental Study of Capabilities and Trade-offs
abstract: arXiv:2608.14765v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Data cleaning without a trusted clean reference is challenging because unusual values may represent either genuine errors or valid observations. This paper studies how different agent capabilities affect reference-free data cleaning and proposes an evidence-grounded framework that combines structured context, profiling, LLM reasoning, executable checks, controlled evidence retrieval, source ranking, citation alignment, conservative repair, reversible scripts, and provenance logging. Seven configurations are evaluated across financial, clinical, and environmental-monitoring datasets using controlled synthetic corruption and original-data descriptive analysis, resulting in 126 completed runs. The evaluation includes two comparison baselines and a progressive LLM-based sequence that adds executable tools, evidence retrieval, evidence controls, and conservative repair. translated_title: 无干净参考的智能体数据清洗：能力与权衡的实验研究
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.14765v1 公告类型：新  摘要：在没有可信干净参考的情况下进行数据清洗具有挑战性，因为异常值可能代表真正的错误，也可能是有效的观测值。本文研究了不同智能体能力如何影响无参考数据清洗，并提出了一种基于证据的框架，该框架结合了结构化上下文、配置分析、LLM推理、可执行检查、受控证据检索、来源排序、引用对齐、保守修复、可逆脚本和溯源日志。通过在金融、临床和环境监测数据集上使用受控合成损坏和原始数据描述性分析，评估了七种配置，共完成126次运行。评估包括两个比较基线和一条渐进式基于LLM的序列，该序列添加了可执行工具、证据检索、证据控制和保守修复。在合成评估中，确定性配置分析基线达到了...
tldr: 本文提出了一种无需干净参考的智能体数据清洗框架，通过结合LLM推理、证据检索和保守修复等能力，在多个数据集上系统评估了不同配置的效能与权衡。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes an agentic data cleaning framework that operates without a clean reference, systematically evaluating the capabilities and trade-offs of different configurations combining LLM reasoning, evidence retrieval, and conservative repair across multiple datasets.
